rows.title: Console acquisition lifetime and release
rows.validation: Donor tracks successful acquisition and FreeConsole in destructor. Current Console is local to start: copying donor destructor directly would detach at start return.
rows.next_step: Decide lifetime/restore semantics, test inherited console and failed startup; move ownership only with documented product decision

rows.title: Ownership of process environment writes on rollback/stop
rows.validation: Donor preserves pre-existing variables and removes tracked newly-created values. Current publication has different RE policy; no native failure reproduction in this review.
rows.next_step: Specify prior-value preservation, failed startup and concurrent host modification. Never delete another owner's later value by copying a written-bit mask blindly.

rows.title: IOCP completion/backpressure/handshake/grant/FIFO/retirement
